svg.title: E01: Inheritance and polymorphic routing collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Evolution · A² A1/A3 · tree role collaboration
Harness variants share a base abstraction.
A base-typed slot dispatches to a concrete
Any accepted subtype honors the base contract at
Subtype overrides do not narrow required
Unsupported subtype behavior raises or is
1 register(variant) → 2 create() → 3 select(route) → 4 evaluate(invariant) → 5 allow_or_reject() → 6 execute(subtype)
Evidence: 37/41 repositories, 33/36 families; 37 trajectories (17 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Class inheritance, interfaces, protocols, and plugin subclasses.
Negative control: A class hierarchy with no harness dispatch does not count.
